comment: THE DEAD-EXPORT FENCE baseline. RE-SEEDED 2026-07-14 (R4-C). An export listed here is exported by a LIVE file but has NO live caller — and a TEST IS NEVER A CALLER. A CALLER is: a code reference in another live module; an intra-module reference (definition + >=1 real call, e.g. completeTaskPlan -> completeExecution inside actions.js); a CALL in a shipped instruction surface — the name invoked as name( or referenced as require('./x').name; or a declared export root. A BARE PROSE TOKEN (even a backtick code-span that merely NAMES the function, e.g. the token completeExecution written between backticks) and COMMENTS are NOT callers — a citation is not an invocation. RATCHET: maxDead may only ever be LOWERED and entries only ever REMOVED (by wiring or deleting). RE-SEED PROVENANCE (R4-C): R4-B credited any identifier inside a FENCED code block, which (1) buried 23 genuinely-reachable exports that CTOC recipes invoke with INLINE code — including approveSubplans (the Gate-3 done-all gate, approveSubplans(parentSlug,'review') at menu.md:46), declineComplianceRegime(), dismissStale(), writeActiveProfiles(), completeVision(), and the vision-decomposer/eu-compliance recipe calls — all now credited by their name( call and REMOVED here; and (2) FALSELY credited src/lib/ui.js#doctor via unrelated fenced tokens (clinic doctor, mix doctor in skill docs) — under call syntax that false credit is gone and doctor is revealed as the pre-existing dead export it always was (a UI formatter nothing renders), ADDED here as pre-existing debt and reported to the human for wiring or deletion. completeExecution stays LIVE via its intra-file code edge only (it is named in surfaces solely as a bare token).
